_comment: Sample deploy-guard config. Copy to config.json and edit for your fork. The real config.json is gitignored (per-fork, contains your project list). All paths/projects below are placeholders.

review_models._comment: Optional. Override plan-review model/effort per reviewer id (argon|codex|muse). Allowed families: argon=gemini-*-argon-*, codex=gpt-*, muse=muse-* (excluding -low/-none/-minimal); allowed effort: medium|high|xhigh|max. Resolved review_models binds into input_manifest_sha256, so changing it invalidates open-plan review receipts and judge verdicts.
